authorized_range_utc: 2026-08-31T20:00:00Z open time of the last confirmation bar

purpose_split.overlap_continuity: 2025-01-01..2025-12-31T20:00 (2190 bars) compared field-exact against the frozen lake parquet

acquisition_contract.pagination: sequential startTime pages, limit 1000; each page's first open_time must equal the previous page's last open_time + 14400000 ms; no duplicates, no gaps, no overlaps; page order persisted
receipts_per_page: sha256 of the raw response bytes
acquisition_contract.staging_root: a NEW restricted local staging directory outside every repository and outside the canonical lake; original response bytes and receipts only; the canonical lake and the frozen predictor CSVs are NEVER written
row_validation: OHLC finite, positive, high >= max(open,close), low <= min(open,close)
no duplicate or open bars: terminal bar close_time must precede acquisition time
any missing grid bar inside the confirmation interval refuses
acquisition_contract.hard_boundaries: HTTP GET only; no credentials, account endpoints, websockets, order endpoints or trading actions; no other exchange, symbol, market type or synthetic substitute
acquisition_contract.overlap_comparison: float64(api decimal string) must equal the frozen lake parquet value BITWISE for open/high/low/close/volume/quote_volume/taker fields and integer-exact for open_time/close_time/trade_count on all 2190 overlap bars; any difference is a revision and stops before feature generation

role_ledger.grid: UTC H4 bars at 00/04/08/12/16/20; row indexing continues the frozen with-warmup frame (start 2017-08-17T04:00)

roles.calibration: 2025-01-01T00:00 .. 2025-12-31T20:00 (previously consumed; hyperparameter selection and refit only)
roles.reserved_future: bars after 2026-08-31T20:00 are absent from this experiment; their labels and scores are not inspected

role_ledger.purge_rule: max target horizon = 12 bars. FIT/CAL: anchors whose label window (a, a+12] crosses 2025-12-31T20:00 are excluded from every label set. BLOCKS: scoring anchors are excluded when fewer than 12 bars remain before the block end, so no label crosses any block or role boundary. Features are past-only, so block starts need no purge.
role_ledger.anchor_sampling: stride 4 raw bars; per block, anchors are block rows at offsets 0,4,8,... from the block's first bar, minus the purged tail. Fit/cal anchors use the same stride-4 rule from each role's first bar.
role_ledger.missing_bar_treatment: EXECUTABLE: the confirmation interval must be a complete 1458-bar grid; any missing bar makes its block incomplete; with fewer than four complete blocks the verdict is FRESH_CONFIRMATION_INSUFFICIENT — the split is never redesigned after inspection
role_ledger.insufficient_rule: FRESH_CONFIRMATION_INSUFFICIENT if any of the four blocks is incomplete after warmup and purge

analysis_contract.label_builder: agent_plugins.branch_pretraining.barrier_hit_labels — trailing_realized_vol_close_to_close lookback 64, upper_mult 2.0, lower_mult 2.0, epsilon 1e-8, adverse-first same-bar collision (frozen contract verbatim)

frozen_arms.arm1_prior_fitcal: class prior estimated from the SAME fit+calibration label set every fitted arm uses
frozen_arms.arm2_scale_only: multinomial logistic on the current past-only barrier scale (lag 0)
frozen_arms.arm3_scale_lags: multinomial logistic on barrier-scale lags 0-3 (lag k at anchor-4k raw bars)
frozen_arms.arm4_summary_only: multinomial logistic on the fixed 249-value causal summary (per input channel: last value, mean, std over the trailing 64-bar preprocessed observation window, exactly as audited)
frozen_arms.arm5_scale_plus_summary: multinomial logistic on scale lags 0-3 concatenated with the 249 summary

analysis_contract.frozen_machinery: identical to the accepted attribution audit: fit-role-only standardization; logistic C grid [0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0] selected on CALIBRATION multiclass log loss only; refit on fit+calibration with the selected C; lbfgs max_iter 2000; probabilities clipped 1e-12; observation windows from the same contract observation pipeline (window 64, 83 channels)
analysis_contract.no_2026_choice: no 2026 score may choose a model, hyperparameter, threshold, feature, block or baseline; every choice above is frozen here
metrics: multiclass log loss (primary; no hard accuracy as primary)
class support per block and role
calibration deciles of predicted hit probability
paired per-observation loss differences for every contrast
analysis_contract.uncertainty: within-block circular block bootstrap on per-observation multiclass log-loss differences, block length 6 sampled anchors, B = 2000, RNG seed 707 (new, fixed here), one-sided H1 mean > 0, minimum Monte Carlo p reported as <= 1/2001; Holm across the eight contrasts via agent_plugins.paired_inference.holm_adjust

licenses.class_support: classes 0 and 1 each >= 15 scoring anchors per block per horizon (blocks are ~40% of an N2 216-row window whose sealed threshold was 30; scaled and fixed pre-result)
licenses.available_blocks: >= 8 non-overlapping bootstrap blocks per score block (86/6 = 14 minimum, structurally satisfied when blocks are complete)
licenses.finiteness: any non-finite loss or degenerate fit is a license failure

analysis_contract.seeds_note: no fitted arm here is stochastic (lbfgs deterministic); if any optimizer randomness appears it describes optimization variability and is never the statistical sample size
analysis_contract.fit_anchor_warmup_floor_amendment: PRE-SCORE AMENDMENT (no 2026 score existed when sealed; the first execution refused at FITTING because the earliest fit anchors precede the feature warmup): fit/cal anchors additionally require row index >= 321 (= 256-bar causal scaling window + 64-bar observation window + 1) so every arm feature is computable; anchors below the floor are EXCLUDED from fitting, never imputed. The floor is pure data-independent geometry. A hard finiteness gate refuses (typed) any remaining non-finite feature cell instead of imputing or silently dropping it.

parity_tolerances_d3.regeneration: the COMPLETE causal feature history is regenerated from raw OHLCV (2017-08-17 onward) through the last allowed August bar via the bound Stage 2.1/2.2/3.1 chain — never an appended suffix with hidden state
parity_tolerances_d3.exact_classes: DATE_TIME strings, raw OPEN/HIGH/LOW/CLOSE/VOLUME, typical_price recomputation, and the two true binary features vol_regime_high/low must be EXACT on every overlapping row; timestamp order and column order must be exact
parity_tolerances_d3.numeric_envelope: for the remaining features, per cell: bit-exact float32 equality is the expectation; the acceptance envelope, derived from the frozen pipeline's float32 sanitize and CSV round-trip, is |abs dev| <= 1e-6 OR |rel dev| <= 1e-5; maximum absolute and relative deviations are recorded per feature; any cell outside the envelope is SOURCE_OR_PIPELINE_DRIFT
parity_tolerances_d3.no_weakening: tolerances are never weakened after observing any 2026 value
structural_refusals: forward filling across a missing market bar in the extension
a changed warmup population (regeneration must start 2017-08-17T04:00)
parity_tolerances_d3.hashing: every raw page, intermediate table, final extended table and the role ledger are sha256-hashed into receipts; bulk data is never committed — only sanitized manifests, contracts, tests and aggregate evidence

execution_d4.device: CPU only under this order; GPU requires the conditional gate of §8
execution_d4.unit_grain: one unit = (horizon, block): all five arms' per-observation losses inside; 2 x 4 = 8 units
execution_d4.budget: two wall-clock hours campaign ceiling; minute heartbeat with completed/total and ETA; stop file N3_STOP with terminate semantics; terminal result records; no retry of a terminal scientific result
execution_d4.bundle: self-contained sanitized bundle (identities, role ledger, per-unit payloads, digests) reproducible WITHOUT the private staging root; offline verifier rederives the complete decision and refuses the ten ordered adversaries

precedence: FRESH_CONFIRMATION_INSUFFICIENT if any block incomplete (role ledger rule)
FRESH_CONFIRMATION_INCONCLUSIVE if any license, unit, identity or execution requirement fails

INCREMENTAL_REPRESENTATION_CANDIDATE_ON_FRESH_DATA if ANY representation contrast (arm3-arm2, arm4-arm1, arm5-arm2, either horizon) has all four blocks positive AND pooled skill >= 0.005 AND Holm p < 0.05
TARGET_SCALE_EFFECT_CONFIRMED_NO_REPRESENTATION_SIGNAL if no representation contrast passes AND scale-vs-prior passes on BOTH horizons (all four blocks positive, pooled skill >= 0.01, Holm p < 0.05)
